description: FR-C7-01 and FR-C7-02. A license is a payload plus an Ed25519 signature. Verification uses a caller-supplied public key and does not need the network. The package source must not contain a private key.
scope: verify_license returns claims for a good signature
A flipped signature byte returns invalid bad_signature
The license module source contains no private key block
acceptanceCriteria: A document signed with a test Ed25519 key verifies back to the claims, including license_id lic-1 and features. One flipped signature byte yields state invalid and reason bad_signature. license.py does not contain BEGIN PRIVATE KEY. FR-C7-01 FR-C7-02.
constraints: Do not ship a private key in source or sample config.
Do not call a network during verify.
Do not accept a document whose signature does not match the payload bytes.
workerGuidance: Small local model rule: solve only the active subtask. Do not implement later CTX tasks early.
Every test function for this task's subtasks must contain that slice token, for example CTX_024_1.
After writing or changing a test, always call the declared pytest command before ending the turn. Do not stop with explanation text only.
If the active subtask's verification already passes because earlier work implemented it correctly, run the declared command and mark the subtask done. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
Keep edits inside targetArtifacts unless the subtask explicitly says otherwise.
When writing tests, assert only the current subtask's scope so later subtasks still have meaningful work.
